authority: Assistant-authored architectural proposal; user requested comprehensive plan, no runtime/flight/production action from this file
releaseGoal: BETA_SIM complete within explicit support matrix, plus hardware-ready adapter/bench kit; physical-device/real-flight gates separate

milestones.title: Release baseline
milestones.userOutcome: Khóa product line, cấu hình, dependency, corpus, budget và current defects
milestones.exitGate: Dependency closure/pins/license/preflight install plan hợp lệ; missing-path disposition rõ; không đổi frozen

milestones.title: Flight runtime bền vững
milestones.exitGate: Recorder không tràn trong30min; closed timer bất biến; full frames/fsync; actual link/AP reboot và neutral takeover đạt

milestones.title: Mission workbench
milestones.userOutcome: Lập và thực hiện polygon/corridor/inspection/search trong cùng cockpit
milestones.exitGate: KML/QGC semantic oracle + geo/Home/upload/readback; AUTO/Hold/resume/RTL/review đạt

milestones.title: Payload, video và crew
milestones.userOutcome: Hai operator,4 peer payload và file ảnh geotag
milestones.exitGate: Same-release task đồng thời video/capture/flight; đúng route/lease, lost-link/reboot, geotag và SAF receiver

milestones.title: Simulator và cockpit
milestones.userOutcome: Diễn tập bằng3D/audio/môi trường và UX có thể dùng
milestones.exitGate: FID2/corpus/ground-truth; media stale/audio capture; all-screen visual/input and formative human gate

milestones.title: Qualification release
milestones.userOutcome: Một bộ APK/host vượt campaign tích hợp
milestones.exitGate: Toàn MUST pass, same release/config,18 polygon/corridor nominals + các nhóm khác, faults, perf,24h, receiver/persistence,0P0/P1

milestones.title: Handoff và bench kit
milestones.userOutcome: Nhóm khác tự cài và chuẩn bị nối HeraHub
milestones.exitGate: Independent install/run/review, configuration matrix, known limits, provider contracts và bench/HIL intake hoàn chỉnh

requirements.title: Release/dependency closure
requirements.acceptance: Selected source/config/fonts/definitions có đủ SHA/type/license; missing paths được xử lý trong isolated intake; clean install closure kiểm được

requirements.title: Supported profile và pairing
requirements.acceptance: Chốt API/ABI/OS/WebView/GPU/codec/AP/model; loopback mặc định, LAN pairing có cert/nonce/auth/expiry; WebView origin/bridge allowlist; không cleartext control ra LAN hoặc tự chọn thiết bị

requirements.title: Recorder và clock closure
requirements.acceptance: Đủ RX/INTENT/SENT/CRC/chain/CLOSE hoặc explicit failure; không overwrite/unread/tràn; elapsed đóng đúng1lần; 30min kiểm capacity thật

requirements.title: Authority/session/input
requirements.acceptance: Wrong boot/target/operator/sequence/stale bị chặn; neutral claim/release; native focus/deadman; HB1500ms/lease200ms; không tự restore

requirements.title: Manual/assisted flight
requirements.acceptance: Actual APK takeoff/manual pitch+yaw/Hold/POI/orbit/RTL/LAND với ACK+observed state+ground truth; không force-arm hoặc UI animation thay execution

requirements.title: Mất link và AP reboot thật
requirements.acceptance: Injection chứng minh socket/byte loss hoặc actual boot/PID đổi; pending UNKNOWN, revoke; reconnect cần discover/preflight/consent mới; failsafe quan sát theo typed config

requirements.title: Mission model và KML/QGC
requirements.acceptance: Một semantic model; positive/negative held-out corpus; camera commands/frames/altitude/speed giữ nghĩa; unsupported complex/fence/rally từ chối rõ

requirements.title: Geo/Home/terrain
requirements.acceptance: WGS84/ENU/NED/Home/relative/AMSL/AGL/geoid/time/source/no-data kiểm độc lập; không ngầm chuyển datum; readback nằm tolerance theo encoding/projection

requirements.title: AUTO/Hold/resume/refly intent
requirements.acceptance: Plan→compile→upload/readback→Home review→AUTO→reached→ground/disarm→review; Hold/resume/RTL consent và MIS_RESTART typed; refly phần thiếu là plan mới được duyệt

requirements.title: Airspace/geofence/return
requirements.acceptance: Nguồn vùng trời synthetic có tuổi/coverage; fenceAP upload/readback/breach; preview return/alternate/reserve; UNKNOWN không thành permission

requirements.title: Payload capability/4 peer routing
requirements.acceptance: 4 peer có ID riêng; capability-driven UI; manager/device mapping đúng; foreign/late/ambiguous ACK không mở quyền; unsupported command từ chối

requirements.title: Hai operator độc lập
requirements.acceptance: Hai authenticated clients/processes/session histories; flight và per-payload authority riêng; consent handoff/contention/partition/revoke; feed switch không chuyển quyền

requirements.title: Video xuyên mission
requirements.acceptance: Ghi từng chặng clock/seq, toàn khoảngAUTO và min-binFPS/maxgap; cold-start/codec/queue/error; source idle paused; không deduce photon từ canvas

requirements.title: Camera file/exposure/geotag
requirements.acceptance: Sim camera tạo image file, exposure/index/sourceSHA/UTC-or-bracket/pose/datum; EXIF chỉ khi đúng nghĩa, sidecar đầy đủ; unknown time/geo đánh uncertainty; hardware-photo count0

requirements.title: Mapping readiness/quality
requirements.acceptance: Stable lens/focus/mount/shutter/time sync, planned vs achieved footprint, GSD/overlap/blur; fixed không đồng nghĩa mọi gimbal sai; simulated coverage không là accuracy thật

requirements.title: Physics fidelity/envelope
requirements.acceptance: Phiên bảnmass/inertia/CG/rotor/lag/drag/battery/wind/contact/sensor; frame/time oracle và held-out seeds; FID2 required; Hera constants vẫn assumptions trước calibration

requirements.title: Obstacles/contact/motor/payload swing
requirements.acceptance: Avoidance sensor đi quaAP, contact riêng; dropout khi vẫn giữ cần; pitch+yaw,1/2/3motorfault, pendulum/headwind có expected bounded behavior/loss outcome; không giả all faults controllable

requirements.title: 3D/audio source-truth
requirements.acceptance: Pose/camera/sensor bám cùng run/clock, scene stale freeze, rotor/audio muted đúng; licensed PBR assets; actual audio capture và FPS target; weather visual/physics tách rõ

requirements.title: Training/instructor/debrief
requirements.acceptance: Manual+assisted+AUTO bài thực tế; instructor faults tách authority; input/clock/events timeline và report, scripted vs human rõ; không tổng điểm kỹ năng bay thật chưa validated

requirements.title: Cockpit UI/input quality
requirements.acceptance: Token/grid/rail alignment, đủcontrast/touch targets, 2themes/sunmoon, allscreens/popup/IME/insets/error, safe takeover; simulated HID contract và actual Android touch

requirements.title: Workspace/review/restart
requirements.acceptance: Durable workspace+review, cold Android/host restart; no authority restore; receipt/data/plan/raw identities giữ nguyên; không success từ last historical pose

requirements.title: Dataset/SAF/receiver
requirements.acceptance: Large file export/checkpoint/resume/receipt; thiếu/hỏng/sai receiver/replay từ chối; independently reconstruct từ original; metadata-only phải ghi external raw not embedded

requirements.title: Quota/archive/resources
requirements.acceptance: Admission20/floor10+reserve256/forecast15; no autodrop/delete; ENOSPC/EIO/fsync/pending/reserve export; control ưu tiên dưới overload; cap queues/RAM/RSS/guest

requirements.title: Performance và endurance
requirements.acceptance: Same-final-release metrics, cold/nominal/fault,1x/frame/fsync, 30min→2h→8h→24h uninterrupted active-loop on admitted target; no time stitching/no replay substitution

requirements.title: Beta install/update/security
requirements.acceptance: APK cert/hash/SBOM/licenses + host prerequisite/package verifier; no privatekeys; schema upgrade failure giữ original; MITM/replay/origin/simulator boundary/cold migration checked

requirements.title: Receiver/user acceptance
requirements.acceptance: Nhóm nhận độc lập install/pair/plan/fly/fault/review/export không developer shell rescue;5formative users/5tasks,≥90%completion,0criticalerrors; NOT_CHECKED nếu thiếu human

requirements.title: Hardware-ready adapter kit
requirements.acceptance: Versioned MCU/HID/radio/AP/payload contract, diagnostics/calibration & bench/HIL scripts; exact model/firmware unknown registry/owner; không hardware capability claim

requirements.title: Release truth and limits
requirements.acceptance: Toàn MUST cùng release/config,0P0/P1, knownunsupported visible; feature/data/simulator/replay/actual sources tách; no DJI superiority/NDAA/endurance/realflight claim thiếu proof

metrics.name: Control safety
metrics.method: raw TX+native intent+authority journal; clock age brackets

metrics.name: Physics pacing
metrics.target: speedup1/cap500ms/fsync-before-sensor; aggregate RTF≥1.000 nominal; đầy đủ frame
metrics.method: independent WAL+AP required-stage correlation+host/guest uncertainty; insufficient clock→INCONCLUSIVE

metrics.name: Renderer
metrics.method: per-frame render trace; GPU/present/thermal captured separately; no photon claim

metrics.name: RGB video
metrics.method: all frame source/encode/network/decode/canvas IDs; independent parser full interval

metrics.name: Cold start
metrics.target: firstvalidRGBframe≤1500ms after explicit start on primaryprofile
metrics.method: at least3 cold starts with source/decoder startup clock brackets

metrics.name: UI responsiveness
metrics.method: actual Android native input→visible feedback; ACK separately

metrics.name: Touch/contrast
metrics.method: layout measurements +adaptive scene backgrounds + human task observation

metrics.name: Storage
metrics.method: live host/guest observer and lossless-size estimate with reserve; no evidence deletion

metrics.name: User tasks
metrics.method: script/time/errors/recovery logs; not statistical DJI superiority certification

metrics.name: Endurance
metrics.target: 30min→2h→8h→24h actual closedloop, uninterrupted singleinterval at final release

metrics.name: Exposure/geotag
metrics.method: independent image/sidecar/exposure groundtruth reconstruction; not realcameraaccuracy
